description: This Java class defines the 'PatientIdentifierType' entity for the OpenMRS project, including its fields, enums, and basic methods.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierType
classes.description: Represents the configuration and metadata for different types of patient identifiers within OpenMRS, including validation rules, formatting, and behavior regarding location and uniqueness.

methods.name: getFormatDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the identifier format.

methods.name: setFormatDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the identifier format.

methods.name: getRequired
methods.description: Returns whether the identifier type is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the identifier type is required.

methods.name: getLocationBehavior
methods.description: Returns the location behavior enum indicating if location is required or not used.

methods.name: getUniquenessBehavior
methods.description: Returns the uniqueness behavior enum indicating how duplicates are handled.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format string for the identifier.

methods.name: setFormat
methods.description: Sets the format string for the identifier.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of this identifier type.

methods.name: setPatientIdentifierTypeId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of this identifier type.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Returns the validator string if any exists.

methods.name: hasValidator
methods.description: Checks if a validator is configured (non-empty validator string).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation (name) of this identifier type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements the getId method from OpenmrsObject, returning the identifier type ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements setting the ID from OpenmrsObject, sets the identifier type ID.
